sources: ASHRAE/ACCA/ANSI Standard 180-2018, Standard Practice for Inspection and Maintenance of Commercial Building HVAC Systems (baseline tasks and frequencies): https://www.acca.org/standards/technical/standard-180

EPA Section 608 refrigerant management and leak repair (40 CFR 82.157) / AIM Act ER&R rule (40 CFR 84.106): https://www.epa.gov/section608 and https://health.hawaii.gov/cab/files/2026/03/AIM-Act-Compliance-Guide-for-Small-Businesses.pdf
RTU inspection checklist items (filters, belts, economizer, coils, electrical, HX): https://safetyculture.com/library/property-and-facilities-management/rtu-inspection-8geq2vxcjnz9xmwj
Chiller log practice (CHW supply/return, approaches, oil, amps, purge): https://hvac-talk.com/vbb/threads/309742-Chiller-log
Capacitor replacement tolerance ±6 % of rating and equal-or-higher voltage (Regal Rexnord / Genteq application notes); NEMA MG-1 motor nameplate voltage ±10 %
ANSI Z21.47 / CSA 2.3 (400 ppm air-free CO ceiling for furnaces) and NCI combustion performance guidance (100 ppm air-free action level)
Manitowoc and Hoshizaki ice machine cleaning and sanitizing instructions (every 6 months minimum; more often with poor water quality)
Research notes: scratchpad research/workflow-needs.md (commercial tech workflow needs, PM items per equipment type)

templates.name: Packaged rooftop — gas heat / electric cooling
templates.appliesTo: Packaged RTUs with a gas-fired heat section (Carrier 48TC, Trane Precedent/Voyager YSC, Lennox LGH, York ZF, AAON RN with gas heat and similar).

items.label: Filters replaced (size and quantity noted)
items.hint: Record size × count so the next visit brings the right ones; note loaded filters as a static-pressure cause.

items.label: Belts: condition, tension and sheave alignment checked
items.hint: Deflection ≈ 1/64 in. per inch of span; glazed, cracked or dusty belts are replaced; check sheave wear with a gauge.

items.label: Blower motor amps vs nameplate FLA
items.hint: Clamp one leg with the filters in; amps well under FLA with low airflow points to a slipping belt or wrong sheave.

items.label: Total external static pressure
items.hint: Supply + return magnitude; compare with the nameplate/design static (PSC blowers ≈ 0.5 in. wc max, ECM ≈ 0.8–1.0).

items.label: Evaporator coil clean, no ice or oil stains
Condensate drain and pan clear, trap primed, overflow switch tested
Cooling delta-T (return − supply)
items.hint: Typically 16–22 °F at design airflow; low with wet coil = low capacity or high airflow, high = low airflow.

items.label: Economizer actuator strokes fully open and closed on command
items.hint: Command 2 V / 10 V (or use the controller test mode); the damper must move freely without binding.

items.label: Damper blades and linkage free, seals intact, minimum position set
OAT / MAT / RAT or enthalpy sensors read plausibly (within 2 °F of a reference)
Mixed-air low limit (freeze protection) set and functional
Supply voltage L-L (unit running)
items.hint: Within ±10 % of the nameplate rating; imbalance above 2 % between legs needs investigation.

items.label: Compressor running amps vs RLA (per circuit)
Contactors: no pitting, no chatter, drop across closed poles < 0.5 V under load
Run capacitor µF under load (enter rated µF)
items.hint: µF = 2652 × A ÷ V on the capacitor lead; replace outside ±6 % of the printed rating or if bulged/leaking.

items.label: Wiring, lugs and terminals tight, no discoloration; disconnect and fuses correct
Safeties verified (HPS, LPS, freeze stat, limit, rollout) — none bypassed
Condenser coil cleaned (both faces on multi-row), fins straight
Condenser fan motors and blades: bearings quiet, correct rotation, amps normal
Superheat (per circuit, with validity: ≥ 65 °F outdoor, 10+ min runtime)
Subcooling (per circuit)
Visual/electronic leak check of joints, drier, valves (log any add in the refrigerant log)
Heat exchanger inspected (cells, crossover, rust/cracks) — combustion analyzer check
items.hint: Visual plus CO in the supply air with burners on; any crack or CO rise in the supply = out of service.

items.label: Flue CO air-free at steady state
items.hint: CO air-free = CO × 20.9 ÷ (20.9 − O2). Action above 100 ppm; 400 ppm is the ANSI Z21.47 ceiling.

items.label: Flame sense signal (µA DC) and igniter condition
items.hint: Typical 2–10 µA; most boards drop out near 0.5 µA. Clean the rod with fine abrasive, never sandpaper residue.

items.label: Manifold gas pressure at high fire (and inlet pressure)
items.hint: Natural gas manifold typically 3.5 in. wc; LP 10 in. wc; set per the rating plate.

items.label: Temperature rise within the nameplate range
Burners, venting and combustion air clear; inducer and pressure switch hoses sound
Thermostat / BAS: calls verified at the board (Y1/Y2/W1/G), schedule and setpoints sane
Board fault history read and cleared (record codes)
Cabinet panels, gaskets, hail guards and curb seal intact; no water intrusion
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Packaged rooftop — electric heat or cooling only
templates.appliesTo: Packaged RTUs and packaged air handlers without a gas section (cooling only, electric strip heat, hydronic heat).

items.label: Filters replaced (size and quantity noted)
Belts: condition, tension and sheave alignment checked
items.hint: Deflection ≈ 1/64 in. per inch of span.

items.label: Blower motor amps vs nameplate FLA
Total external static pressure
Evaporator coil clean, no ice or oil stains
Condensate drain and pan clear, trap primed, overflow switch tested
Cooling delta-T (return − supply)
Economizer actuator strokes fully open and closed on command
Damper blades and linkage free, seals intact, minimum position set
OAT / MAT / RAT or enthalpy sensors read plausibly
Mixed-air low limit (freeze protection) set and functional
Supply voltage L-L (unit running)
Compressor running amps vs RLA (per circuit)
Contactors: no pitting, no chatter, drop across closed poles < 0.5 V under load
Run capacitor µF under load (enter rated µF)
Wiring, lugs and terminals tight, no discoloration; disconnect and fuses correct
Safeties verified (HPS, LPS, freeze stat, heater limits) — none bypassed
Electric heat kW measured (V × A × √3 ÷ 1000 on 3-phase) vs nameplate ±10 %
items.hint: All stages energized with airflow proven; low kW = open element, fusible link or stage not called.

items.label: All heat stages sequence on command; fusible links and limits intact
Condenser coil cleaned, fins straight
Condenser fan motors and blades: bearings quiet, correct rotation, amps normal
Superheat (per circuit, valid conditions only)
Subcooling (per circuit)
Leak check of joints, drier, valves (log any add in the refrigerant log)
Thermostat / BAS: calls verified at the board, schedule and setpoints sane
Board fault history read and cleared (record codes)
Cabinet panels, gaskets and curb seal intact; no water intrusion
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Split system — condensing unit + air handler / furnace coil
templates.appliesTo: Split cooling systems (condensing unit outdoors, coil on a furnace or air handler indoors).

items.label: Filters replaced (size noted)
Evaporator coil clean; blower wheel clean
Condensate drain clear, trap primed, float switch tested
Blower motor amps vs FLA
Total external static pressure
Cooling delta-T (return − supply)
Condenser coil cleaned, clearance maintained
Condenser fan motor and blade: bearings, rotation, amps
Supply voltage at the disconnect (unit running)
Compressor running amps vs RLA
Run capacitor µF under load (enter rated µF)
Contactor contacts and coil; wiring and disconnect sound
Superheat (fixed orifice: total SH vs chart; TXV: evaporator SH 8–12 °F)
Subcooling vs nameplate target (TXV)
Leak check: service valves, caps, drier, coil U-bends; line insulation intact
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Heat pump (air-source split or packaged)
templates.appliesTo: Air-source heat pumps including packaged heat-pump RTUs and water-source heat pumps (skip the outdoor coil items on water-source units).

items.label: Filters replaced (size noted)
Indoor coil and blower wheel clean
Condensate drain clear, overflow switch tested
Total external static pressure
Blower motor amps vs FLA
Outdoor coil cleaned; defrost drain path clear, unit level on its pad/stand
Reversing valve shifts on O/B command (no leak-by: < 3–4 °F across the suction-side tubes)
Defrost cycle forced and observed (sensor/board, termination, outdoor fan off, strip heat on)
Auxiliary / emergency heat stages energize and kW measured vs nameplate
Superheat (cooling mode, valid conditions) or heating check chart reading
Subcooling (cooling mode)
Leak check of valves, accumulator, drier and coil joints (log any add in the refrigerant log)
Supply voltage (unit running)
Compressor running amps vs RLA
Run capacitor µF under load (enter rated µF)
Contactor, crankcase heater, wiring and disconnect sound; safeties not bypassed
Thermostat configured for heat pump (O/B polarity, aux lockout, balance point)
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Air-cooled chiller
templates.appliesTo: Air-cooled scroll and screw chillers (Trane CGAM, Carrier 30RAP/30RB, York YLAA/YVAA, Daikin AGZ and similar).

items.label: Chilled water supply (leaving) temperature
items.hint: Compare with setpoint; freeze protection typically trips near 36 °F.

items.label: Chilled water return (entering) temperature
items.hint: Design ΔT is usually 10 °F; a small ΔT at high load means high flow or low capacity.

items.label: Evaporator approach (CHW supply − evaporator saturated temp)
items.hint: Healthy ≤ 5 °F; rising approach = fouled tubes, low charge or low flow.

items.label: Condenser approach (condensing saturated temp − entering air)
items.hint: Air-cooled: ≤ 25 °F typical; higher = dirty coil, fan out, recirculation.

items.label: Compressor amps vs RLA (per compressor)
Oil level in the sight glass with the compressor running
Oil pressure / temperature within the manufacturer band
Condenser coils cleaned (microchannel: low-pressure rinse only), fins straight
Condenser fans: rotation, bearings, VFD/fan staging and amps
Supply voltage L-L
Starter/VFD, contactors, lugs torqued, phase monitor set; wiring free of heat damage
Safeties verified: HPS, LPS, flow switch, freeze stat, oil pressure/temperature — none bypassed
Refrigerant leak check (electronic) on joints, valves, sensors; log any add in the refrigerant log
Chilled water flow / pressure drop across the evaporator vs design; strainer cleaned
Glycol concentration / freeze point checked (if applicable)
Controller alarm history reviewed and recorded
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Water-cooled chiller
templates.appliesTo: Water-cooled centrifugal, screw and scroll chillers with a cooling tower or fluid cooler (Trane CVHE/RTHD, Carrier 19XR/23XRV/30XW, York YK/YVWA, Daikin WME and similar).

items.label: Chilled water supply (leaving) temperature
Chilled water return (entering) temperature
Condenser water entering temperature
Condenser water leaving temperature
Evaporator approach (CHW supply − evaporator saturated temp)
items.hint: Healthy ≤ 5 °F (new machines 1–3); trend it — a 3 °F rise over the baseline is the tube-cleaning trigger.

items.label: Condenser approach (condensing saturated temp − leaving condenser water)
items.hint: Healthy ≤ 5 °F; a rise of ~3 °F over the commissioning baseline means fouled tubes — brush/clean.

items.label: Compressor amps vs RLA (and % RLA from the controller)
Oil level in the sight glass with the compressor running
Oil pressure (net / differential) within the manufacturer band
Oil temperature within the manufacturer band
Purge unit run time / pump-outs logged (low-pressure machines); excessive purge = air leak
Condenser tubes brushed / eddy-current test due? (based on approach trend and schedule)
Supply voltage L-L
Starter / VFD inspected: contacts, lugs torqued, cooling fans, fault log
Safeties verified: HPS, LPS, flow switches (CHW and CW), freeze stat, oil safeties — none bypassed
Refrigerant leak check (electronic / standing pressure); log any add in the refrigerant log
Condenser water treatment / tower condition noted; strainers cleaned
Controller alarm history reviewed and recorded
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Walk-in cooler (medium temperature)
templates.appliesTo: Walk-in coolers with a remote or self-contained condensing unit and a unit cooler (evaporator) in the box; box 33–41 °F.

items.label: Box temperature (and thermostat setpoint)
items.hint: Product safety zone 33–41 °F; log as found and as left.

items.label: Door gaskets, closers, sweeps and strip curtains seal; no ice at the frame
items.hint: Dollar-bill test around the gasket; a warm, wet box and a frosted coil start here.

items.label: Evaporator frost pattern even; coil clean; fans run and blow through
items.hint: Frost only at the inlet = low charge/starved TXV; whole coil iced = defrost or airflow problem.

items.label: Defrost initiates and terminates (timer/clock settings or electric heaters checked)
Drain pan and drain line clear, heat tape working, trap outside the box
Evaporator fan motor amps and bearings
Door heaters, lights and alarm/thermometer functional
Condenser coil cleaned; fan motor and blade sound; clearance maintained
Supply voltage (unit running)
Compressor running amps vs RLA
Evaporator superheat (6–10 °F) and total superheat at the compressor (20–30 °F)
Subcooling / sight glass clear, moisture indicator dry
Low-ambient head pressure control (fan cycling / headmaster) functional
Contactor, capacitors, start relay, defrost timer and wiring sound; safeties not bypassed
Leak check; log any add in the refrigerant log
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Walk-in freezer (low temperature)
templates.appliesTo: Walk-in freezers with electric or hot-gas defrost; box −10 to 0 °F.

items.label: Box temperature (and thermostat setpoint)
items.hint: Typically −10 to 0 °F; log as found and as left.

items.label: Door gaskets, heater, closers and sweeps seal; no ice build-up at the frame or floor
Evaporator frost pattern even; no ice bridging between fins after defrost
Defrost heaters draw amps (electric) or hot-gas valve shifts; termination and fan-delay switches work
Defrost frequency and duration appropriate (typically 4×/day, 30–45 min max, terminate on temperature)
Drain pan heater and heated drain line clear and working; trap outside the box
Evaporator fan motor amps and bearings
Door pressure-relief port / vent heater clear (door opens freely after closing)
Condenser coil cleaned; fan motor and blade sound
Supply voltage (unit running)
Compressor running amps vs RLA
Evaporator superheat (6–10 °F) and total superheat at the compressor; discharge temp < 225 °F
Subcooling / sight glass clear, moisture indicator dry
Low-ambient head pressure control functional; crankcase heater energized when off
Contactor, capacitors, start components, defrost timer/board and wiring sound; safeties not bypassed
Leak check; log any add in the refrigerant log
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Ice machine (cuber / flaker)
templates.appliesTo: Commercial ice machines (Manitowoc, Hoshizaki, Scotsman, Ice-O-Matic) with self-contained or remote condensers; 6-month clean and sanitize minimum.

items.label: Clean and sanitize cycle performed per the manufacturer (descale with the approved cleaner, then sanitizer)
items.hint: Every 6 months minimum; more often with hard water, yeast or bakery/brewery air. Remove and clean the water trough, distribution tube, float valve and curtain.

items.label: Evaporator plates / grid free of scale and nickel plating intact
Bin, door, gasket, chute and bin thermostat/sensor clean and sanitized
Water filter replaced (date and model noted); inlet water pressure 20–80 psi
Air filter / condenser filter cleaned
Condenser coil cleaned (air-cooled) or water-regulating valve / remote condenser checked
Freeze and harvest cycle times observed and within the manufacturer chart
items.hint: Long freeze = dirty condenser, low charge or warm water; long harvest = scale on the plates or harvest valve problem.

items.label: Ice cube size/bridge thickness set; cubes clear and full
Water inlet valve, float/level sensor, pump and drain (and dump valve) work; no leaks
Supply voltage
Compressor running amps vs RLA
Discharge pressure near the end of freeze vs the manufacturer chart
Controller diagnostics / fault history read and recorded
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Make-up air unit and kitchen exhaust fans
templates.appliesTo: Kitchen hood exhaust fans (upblast), make-up air units (direct/indirect gas-fired or tempered) and general exhaust fans.

items.label: Lockout/tagout applied at the disconnect before opening the fan; fan verified stopped
Hinged curb / access safe; grease containment present and emptied
Belts condition and tension; sheaves aligned and not worn
items.hint: Grease-laden belts slip and glaze; replace in matched sets.

items.label: Bearings greased / inspected; shaft and wheel free, no wobble
Fan wheel, housing and filters degreased (grease on hood filters and fan = fire load)
Exhaust fan motor amps vs FLA
Fans run on command from the hood controls / fire system interlock and stop correctly
Hood filters in place, undamaged and clean; grease cup emptied
MAU filters replaced (size noted)
Direct-fired burner: profile plates, flame, gas pressure and modulation checked; CO in the discharge measured
items.hint: Direct-fired MAU discharge CO should be low single digits; airflow proving switch must be verified.

items.label: Intake damper / actuator opens fully; airflow proving switch verified
MAU interlocked with exhaust; building pressure reasonable with hoods on
Supply voltage
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer

templates.name: Boiler (hydronic or steam, gas-fired)
templates.appliesTo: Commercial gas-fired hot-water and low-pressure steam boilers (condensing and non-condensing).

items.label: Flue O2 at high fire
items.hint: Typical 3–6 % O2 (excess air 15–35 %); set per the manufacturer's combustion table at high and low fire.

items.label: Flue CO air-free at high fire
items.hint: CO air-free = CO × 20.9 ÷ (20.9 − O2); action above 100 ppm, 400 ppm maximum.

items.label: Net stack temperature
items.hint: Rising stack temperature at the same firing rate = fouled heat-exchange surfaces.

items.label: Manifold and inlet gas pressure at high fire
Burner, igniter, flame rod/scanner and flame signal checked; flame safeguard timings verified
Venting, draft and combustion-air openings inspected; condensate neutralizer serviced (condensing)
Pressure relief valve tested (lift lever) and discharge piping clear; rating matches the boiler
Low-water cutoff tested (blow down float type; test probe type with the test button / lowering the level)
High-limit (and manual-reset high limit) tested; operating control setpoint recorded
Operating pressure and supply/return temperatures logged
Expansion tank charge, fill valve / feedwater and backflow preventer checked
Circulating pumps: amps, seals, couplings, isolation valves
Water treatment / blowdown done (steam); glycol or inhibitor level checked (hydronic)
Supply voltage
Deficiencies / recommendations for the customer
